audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and 2+ item rows read Poppy in both layers while packet.levelChart says Skill for both and the whys say 'trade evenly' and 'even, edging him in 5v5'.
audit.why: Two rows claimed a Poppy advantage the text underneath denies.
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs; the 5/10 ratings already read as even and stay.

audit.why: Levels 2-3 for Poppy and a flat, even scaling curve match the mirror audit's finding that Poppy's Q and E out-trade Zac before Elastic Slingshot exists.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named no Zac ability (packet defect) and used the 'his answer is down' placeholder. Unstable Matter's percent-max-health damage and Cell Division's revive were never stated in the full layer.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot at 21/18/15/12/9s is the longest punish window in the lane and the dash Steadfast Presence grounds; Unstable Matter is a 5s percent-health hit, so armour reads the trade wrong; and killing Zac without clearing bloblets does not kill him.
audit.corrected: Names, the 21s cooldown, the percent-health point and the revive now stated. Mirror wording kept consistent: the dash-stop is the W active, not its passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Don't bodies did not match their headings — 'Let him eat blobs' and 'Get E-knocked-up' both had generic filler.
audit.why: The blob pickups are exactly what refunds his losses, and Stretching Strikes opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.corrected: Each body now answers its heading.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Elastic Slingshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet plus W's resistances let you tank his Q and W, but he is scaling too — an even window.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Zac carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Even, edging him: blob sustain and AoE CC out-anchor a 5v5 while your disruption stays single-target. Play frontline.

edits.before: W-ground his E — step on blobs, E-wall-stun. Poppy wins the Elastic Slingshot cooldown windows.
edits.after: W grounds Elastic Slingshot (21s) — step on his blobs, anti-heal, then E-wall-stun him.

edits.before: E Zac into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall while Elastic Slingshot (21s) is down, Q the zone under him, and step on every blob he sheds.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Standing in Unstable Matter — it is a 5s percent-max-HP hit, so armour does not save you.

edits.before: Dash engage — your W disables it! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — the longest window you will get.

edits.before: E Zac into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops the sling mid-flight and grounds him — hold it for that, not for poke, then E him into terrain.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Cell Division sheds blobs he reabsorbs to heal — walk over each one.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every blob he picks up refunds the trade — anti-heal early and step on them.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Stretching Strikes opens on an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: He revives from surviving bloblets — clear them or the kill does not count.

edits.before: Track Zac's Elastic Slingshot: Dash engage — your W disables it! When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is a 21s dash — W grounds it mid-flight. His W is percent-HP, so armour will not help.

notes: Mirror (zac__poppy) already audited and its findings are consistent with this side — the dash-stop attributed to Poppy's W active rather than its passive, and Poppy owning levels 2-3. Rows 5 and 6 of the chart disagreed with packet.levelChart and their own whys; flipped as one paired group.
